aggressive_definition_excerpt: Polytomous logistic regression models were used to estimate associations of 25(OH)D with risk of total, Gleason 2-6, Gleason 7, and Gleason 8-10 prostate cancer.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control analysis within the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial, with baseline serum measurement and subsequent biopsy ascertainment.
reason: The abstract analyzes both total prostate cancer and incident high-grade Gleason 8-10 prostate cancer. It reports 1,695 total cases and 1,682 controls but does not explicitly state the total analytic N or the number of Gleason 8-10 cases; total N was therefore not inferred by addition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: For Gleason 8-10 prostate cancers, 25(OH)D concentrations were associated with a linear decrease in risk among combined treatment arms [quartile 4 vs. 1: OR, 0.55; 95% confidence interval (CI), 0.32-0.94; P(trend) = 0.04].
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns Gleason 8-10 prostate cancer, an incident high-grade endpoint. The listed 1,695 cases are total prostate cancer cases, not the unavailable number of Gleason 8-10 cases.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
